craft_notes: Sthāyin: hoping to become (abhilāṣa). Device: dash→comma line 1 (entrusting softens), colon→comma + dash-hold line 2 (becoming stated, asking released). Fixes batch-identical L4 (which merely copied L3). Rejected: 'lodge' verb for 'lodging' — kept the gerund's ongoingness; resolving twinless — killed: kept whole, never explained. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Lodging word and thought and body's works in thee, O Master,
grown into thee, twinless, might we be — O ever, O when?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit

reads_against.argmap: Having entrusted speech-mind-body acts in you, O Lord.; Having become you-made, pair-free: may we be even, at any time? → Entrusting all acts in you, may we become you-made and pair-free.
c1_essence: Veda-bodied wish-tree bowed; entrusting all acts to become you-made and pair-free.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
